name: Audio Cue Trainer
description: Train click patterns with audio cues instead of visual timing. Plays a short beep before each scheduled click - you always perform the click yourself.

enabled.name: Enable Audio Cues
enabled.description: Master on/off switch for cue playback.

lead-time-ms.name: Lead Time (ms)
lead-time-ms.description: How many milliseconds BEFORE the scheduled click time the cue sound plays.

latency-comp-ms.name: Audio Latency Compensation (ms)
latency-comp-ms.description: Extra offset to correct for your speakers/headphones output latency.

cue-volume.name: Cue Volume
cue-volume.description: Volume multiplier for the click cue, relative to the game's current SFX volume.
